rules: Do not claim OS Terrain50 values until actual official archive/ASCII bytes are observed and hashed.
Use one area=TQ official download root for TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27; do not make three redundant network downloads.
After archive retrieval, require the exact 10km tile member and verify its ASCII header before sampling.
Sample the prepared pixel-centre cell only after verifying ncols=200, nrows=200, cellsize=50 and expected tile southwest corner.
Do not substitute EA DTM1m or DTM2m values for OS Terrain50 values.
Preserve the three merged official EA measurements at 96% confidence; Increment 167 creates no new numeric result.
Current port 8012 acceptance is downstream of existing-F-host recovery and must not be counted as an independent pending root while the F-host receipt gate is blocked.
Do not create a second task, runner, claim or parallel daemon.
Do not promote canonical status_latest without fresh F-host receipts, heartbeat/claim and accepted current outputs.
